# Anthony Pye

## Overview

- **Gender:** Male  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>
- **Role:** School pupil  <sub>[v2 c5 P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## Appearance

Anthony is described as a cute little boy. He has a dark, sullen little face and black eyes.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)_

## Personality

Anthony is an independent and rather mischievous boy who makes up his own mind about things. He initially holds a strong prejudice against female teachers, treating them with open contempt and a scornful air of toleration. Despite his stubborn nature, he comes to respect authority when dealt with firmly.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_

## Traits

- Independent  <sub>[v2 c7 P6](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0006)</sub>
- Mischievous  <sub>[v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005)</sub>
- Sullen  <sub>[v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004)</sub>

## History

Anthony Pye attended Avonlea School as one of the ten new students when Anne Shirley began her teaching career. Having previously only had male teachers, he held the conviction that female teachers were no good and treated Anne with scornful disdain. Anne initially struggled to reach him through patience and kindness, finding that his passive resistance worried her and affected the other pupils. Eventually, after receiving a physical reprimand from Anne, Anthony changed his opinion of her. He admitted that she had some worth despite being a girl, noting that the whipping she gave him was as good as a man's.

_Sources: [v2 c5 P0](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0000), [v2 c5 P3](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0003), [v2 c5 P4](../source/v02-c05.md#nw-v02-c05-p0004), [v2 c7 P5](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0005), [v2 c7 P7](../source/v02-c07.md#nw-v02-c07-p0007), [v2 c12 P52](../source/v02-c12.md#nw-v02-c12-p0052)_
